craft_notes: Sthāyin: marvel at hidden knowability. Device: em-dashes→commas throughout (knowing stated softly, knowers questioned). Rejected: 'Mattologist' wordplay — killed: never (vighna and smirk in one). Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Uncurtained, untwinned, unshaken in wit-wealth, knowable thou art, forsooth,
yet who be these that know thee, Matted-Crown?
l4.sanskrit_cite: nirāvaraṇanirdvandvaniścalajñānasampadām jñeyo 'si kila ke 'py ete ye tvāṃ jānanti dhūrjaṭe

c1_essence: Devotion-jewel fished from the dread sea conquers all; few know the veiled knowable.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti with prasāda (grace received and returned)
